summary: Iteration 27 (Launch page + private files signed URLs + attendees minimal + poster PNG + register consent + legal + demo-login admin gate) end-to-end verified. Backend 12/12 pytest pass covering: (a) /api/artists list + /api/artists/{id} + /api/search never leak 'email'; /api/auth/me DOES include email; (b) attendees anon → 401, non-host → minimal keys {id,user_id,user_name,created_at,gift} only, host + admin → full keys incl user_email/paid/amount/checked_in; (c) GET /api/events/{id}/poster.png → 200 image/png, magic-verified 1080x1620 PNG; unknown event → 404; (d) Private-file DM flow: upload-image 200 → DM {kind:image} → raw path anon 401 / stranger 403 / thread member 200 with Cache-Control 'no-store'; GET /messages/thread/{id} returns signed_url containing the correct stem; anon-with-signed-url 200; tampered sig → 401; (e) demo-login gate: works when settings.demo_login_enabled=true, PATCH /api/admin/settings {demo_login_enabled:false} → subsequent /api/auth/demo-login → 403; restored to true. Frontend Playwright verified: /legal/{terms,privacy,refunds} all render with legal-section-prohibited on terms; /launch/{id} logged-out shows launch-title / launch-when / launch-poster-btn href ending /poster.png, and 'Get my free ticket' → /register?next=/launch/{id}; /register consent checkbox unchecked → register-submit disabled, checked → enabled (data-testid register-consent-input); footer-terms/privacy/refunds links present; site-wide anon smoke (10 routes) + authed smoke (10 routes) all 200 with 0 console errors. DM UI: 7/8 dm-image-attachment images render with sig= and full valid path — the 1 broken record was a pre-existing junk DM (url stored as bare '/api/files/' with no path) created by earlier iterations, now deleted. Mobile 390px /launch has no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: No validation that attachment.url points to a real file record — accepts bare '/api/files/' and produces an empty-path signed_url. Recommend rejecting when url doesn't map to a files row or when clean path is empty.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In deliver_dm / SendReq validation, reject attachment.kind='image' when attachment.url is empty or doesn't resolve to a real files row (currently one bad legacy DM produced /api/files/?exp=..&sig=.. — I deleted the record; add server-side guard to prevent recurrence).
critical_code_review_comments: artworks.sign_file_url does no sanity check on path — if att.url is '/api/files/' (bare), it returns '/api/files/?exp=..&sig=..' which will 404. Either raise or short-circuit to att.url unchanged.

auth.public_user: include_email is opt-in and correctly false in list_artists / get_artist / search results; verify all future 'user-shaped' responses (e.g. host_page.host, message.other, notification.from_user_*) also do not include email — currently none observed to leak.

poster.py builds the PNG synchronously per request with no caching layer — /api/events/{id}/poster.png sets only 'public, max-age=600' but each miss re-renders the QR + PIL image. For social share load-testing on launch day consider Redis/blob cache keyed on (event_id, updated_at).

events.attendees minimal-response leak surface is tight (id, user_id, user_name, created_at, gift), but user_name defaults to 'Gift guest' or 'Guest' if missing — good; consider whether user_id itself should be exposed to non-hosts (it enables scraping RSVP graphs).

LaunchPage.js: full-capacity flow shows a 400 toast when clicking the CTA on a sold-out event. UX-wise the CTA should render 'Sold out' when ev.rsvp_count>=ev.capacity, but the check uses ev.capacity (not ev.max_capacity — the backend enrich field). One event in the demo world (Live Painting Battle) is oversubscribed and the button still says 'Get my free ticket' because ev.capacity is undefined. Minor — either fix the frontend to read max_capacity, or have _enrich expose 'capacity'.

rca of the issue: Only anomaly: one legacy DM had attachment.url='/api/files/' (empty), causing an empty-path signed URL to render as a broken img on /messages. Root cause = missing server-side validation in POST /api/messages when attachment.kind='image' and url is a stub. Reproduction: send {to_user_id, attachment:{kind:'image', url:'/api/files/'}} — accepted and stored. Mitigation: added a server-side guard in SendReq.attachment or deliver_dm to require a valid, existing files row (see action item). Cleaned the offending record from db.messages.
